comment: Inputs for the complete Windows installer that are not on Hugging Face and never enter Git. The Chinese dictionary comes from this pinned upstream source release; the Japanese SentencePiece tokenizer is an asset on this repository's pinned assets release. The Japanese dictionary now comes from pinned Mozc OSS dictionary_oss 3.35.6354 and is downloaded by scripts/fetch_mozc_dictionary.sh. Every download is checked against the size and SHA-256 recorded here.
